# Augmentation (per-Jump compounding)

- **Status:** ⬜ Pending
- **Skills affected:** Chain Lightning
- **Mechanic tags:** supports, damage-pool, shotgun
- **Backlog:** `CL-AUG-01` (see `docs/INGAME_VERIFICATION_BACKLOG.md`)

## Setup

CL + **Augmentation (Magnificent)** only (no Web — Augmentation excludes it). Parse bare vs with Augmentation; repeat at a high jump count for the compounding test (CL-AUG-02).

## Derived / confirmed formula

Ratio = `(1 + rank_table[rank]) × (1 + per)^total_jumps`. At rank 5, tier-1 per ≈ 5.7%, 2 jumps → ×1.341. At 8 jumps, `1.057⁸ ≈ ×1.56` vs additive ×1.46 (the real compounding discriminator).

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Pending — engine modelled, not game-verified. At 2 jumps compounding vs additive are <0.5% apart; needs a large +Jumps source to prove compounding.
